summary: Streaming SSR now batches the reveal of server-rendered Suspense boundaries for a short time (matching client rendering) instead of swapping each fallback for its content the moment it arrives
useId generates IDs in the form _r_... (underscore delimiters) instead of «r» (19.1) / :r: (19.0), so they are valid CSS selectors, XML names and view-transition-names
A context is now named 'SomeContext' in component stacks, DevTools and warnings instead of 'SomeContext.Provider'
If a server-rendered (dehydrated) Suspense boundary resuspends on the client, React now hides its content and shows the fallback again instead of leaving the stale content visible
When revealing server-rendered content React DOM now waits for pending (suspensey) fonts to load before the reveal instead of revealing immediately
Rendering ARIA 1.3 attributes no longer triggers the DEV unknown-ARIA-attribute warning that it did before
Using a React-owned DOM node that also contains text content as a root container now logs a DEV warning where it was silent before
React DOM passes Trusted Types objects (TrustedHTML/TrustedScript/TrustedScriptURL) through to DOM sinks instead of coercing them to strings, so they now work under a require-trusted-types-for CSP
Concurrent transitions render independently instead of being entangled into one render, so a slow transition no longer delays unrelated ones
DEV now warns when a component appears to have been unblocked by calling use() conditionally, which was silent before
In StrictMode effects are now double-invoked during hydration too, matching client-rendered roots, where hydrated roots were previously exempt
StrictMode's DEV double-invocation no longer re-runs effects for children that only moved (were reordered) rather than remounted
Rendering data-block <script> elements (non-executable types such as application/json) no longer triggers a DEV warning
React.lazy now treats the resolved module's .default export as the canonical component type for identity comparisons instead of the lazy wrapper's own resolution
The DEV DOM-nesting validation for <select> follows the new HTML <select> parser rules, changing which children are allowed inside <select> without a warning
The list of CSS shorthand properties behind the DEV shorthand/longhand style-conflict warning was updated, changing which style combinations warn
defaultValue on <input type=number> is now synced to the DOM the same way as on other input types instead of the number-specific handling used before
credentialless on <iframe> is now a recognized boolean attribute (true renders the bare attribute, false omits it) instead of being rendered as a stringified unknown attribute
When React automatically resets a form after its action completes, the form's onReset handler now fires; previously the automatic reset did not fire it
The FormData handed to a form action is now built with the submitter, so the submitting button's name/value is included as in the native FormData constructor; before it was left out
State updates triggered by resize events are batched until the next frame instead of being processed per event
react-dom/server streaming APIs no longer call onAllReady after the shell has errored, where previously it could still fire
During server-rendering error recovery a tree that never completed is now treated as an error instead of being accepted as finished
